title: SONGPAL TUNDRA TRACE (Throat Singing × Forest Step × Polar Bass) [140]
style: Mongolian Tuvan throat singing meets forest step and polar bass, 140 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched and chopped throat-singing vocal samples only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Mongolian + Sami + te reo Maori, chopped khoomei throat-sing drone samples, morin khuur horse-head fiddle melody phrases, igil bowed strings, jaw harp accents, sparse forest-step half-time kick, deep sliding sub bass, snow-crunch foley percussion, glacial pads, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, vast-tundra-night ritual mood, sidechain ducking pads to kick, festival world-fusion 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(khoomei drone chop, glacial pad, distant jaw harp)
(SONG... PAL... tun... dra... trace...)
(zam... zam... zam...)
(luo... di... luo... di...)

[Build]
(forest-step kick enters, morin khuur climbs, sub slides up)
SONG — PAL! TUN — DRA!
ZAM! ZAM! ZAM!
LUO — DI! LUO — DI!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(jaw harp roll, igil sweep)

[Drop 1]
(half-time forest-step, throat-sing chops, polar sub locked)
TUN — DRA!
TRACE!
FOL — LOW!
CROSS — IT!
(chop stack +7) tiim-tiim-juo-juo / āe-āe-tiim-tiim
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(morin khuur solo phrase, snow foley, chops trade)
(khaana?) (gos?) (kei hea?)
(end!) (dáá!) (konei!)
(yav!) (manne!) (haere!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE TRACE —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to khoomei drone + glacial pad, no kick)
(whispered) songpal... tundra... trace...
(soft) zam... zam...
(soft) luodi... luodi...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(jaw harp builds, forest-step kick returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time forest-step, full throat-sing stack peak, sub doubled)
SONG — PAL — TUN — DRA — TRACE! (tiim tiim tiim!)
FOL — LOW! (yav! manne! haere!)
CROSS — IT! (āe āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(forest-step fades, morin khuur resolves, drone holds)
(songpal... tundra... trace...)
(zam... luodi...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(khoomei drone holds long, fade to silence)
